# MoldGuard Kenya

> MoldGuard Kenya is a mold (mould) removal and remediation company based in Nairobi, Kenya. It inspects, tests and removes mold in homes, apartments, offices and commercial buildings in Nairobi, Mombasa and other towns across Kenya.

## Key facts

- Business name: MoldGuard Kenya
- What it does: mold (mould) removal, mold remediation, mold inspection, laboratory mold testing, black mold removal, air scrubbing, structural drying, indoor air quality improvement
- Phone and WhatsApp: 0710907628 (+254 710 907 628)
- Address: Development House, Moi Avenue, Nairobi, Kenya
- Opening hours: open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Founded: 2015
- Certification: IICRC certified
- Google rating: 4.9 stars from 300+ reviews (https://share.google/rvBrYPkspvx5K0wnz)
- Website: https://moldguardkenya.co.ke
- Online booking: https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/bookings

## Prices (Kenya shillings)

- Site inspection: KES 2,500 flat fee. Includes moisture metering, thermal scanning, an air quality check and a written report with a quotation. The inspection is not free.
- Laboratory mold testing: KES 7,500 per testing kit (one air or surface sample)
- Mold removal, single bathroom: KES 8,500 – 10,000
- Mold removal, standard bedroom: KES 15,000 – 20,000
- 1–2 rooms where wall or ceiling boards must be removed: KES 45,000 – 85,000
- Whole-house or structural remediation: KES 120,000 – 300,000+
- Larger and commercial jobs are quoted after the inspection.

## Areas served

- Nairobi: Nairobi CBD, Westlands, Kilimani, Kileleshwa, Lavington, Karen, Runda, Ngong Road, South B and South C, Embakasi, Kasarani, Roysambu, Thika Road
- Kiambu: Kiambu, Ruiru, Juja, Thika, Kikuyu, Limuru
- Coast: Mombasa, Nyali, Bamburi, Kizingo, Likoni, Diani
- Rift Valley: Nakuru, Naivasha, Gilgil, Eldoret

## Services

- [Mold (mould) removal](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services/mold-removal): process, prices and FAQs
- [Mold inspection](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services/mold-inspection): what the KES 2,500 inspection includes
- [Black mold removal](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services/black-mold-removal): containment and removal of Stachybotrys
- [Mold testing](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services/mold-testing): laboratory air and surface sampling
- [Air scrubbing](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services/air-scrubbing): HEPA filtration of airborne spores
- [Indoor air quality](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services/indoor-air-quality): testing and improvement
- [All services](https://moldguardkenya.co.ke/services)
